About this item

[Unique Style & Sports Vision] - This electric bike for adults features a unique & imaginative design, complete with a cool bike headlight for optimal safety during night rides. The saddle is both delicate & soft, with a strengthened pole & hollowed-out bracket that creates a thrilling sports adventure experience. You'll turn heads with this bike & be the envy of others. Join us & try out the fashion trend.
[1500W High-Speed Motor & 16''x4.0 Fat Tires] - This electric bike is equipped with a powerful 1500W brushless motor with a torque of up to 85Nm. It can easily conquer steep slopes with a gradient of up to 35°. Equipped with 16-inch x 4.0 wide tires, this electric motorcycle is suitable for all terrains, including snow, beaches, mountains and city roads. The professional Shamano 7-speed system ensures precise and sensitive gear shifting.
[3 Riding Modes & Long Distance] - The adult dirt bike offers three riding modes: pure electric, electric assist, and pedal. It features a removable 48V 20AH lithium-ion battery, providing a range of up to 30 miles in pure electric mode and up to 50 miles in pedal assist mode. The UL-certified battery incorporates BMS security protection and power-saving capabilities. With a fast charging time of 4-6 hours at 3A, you can quickly get back on the road.
[Full Suspension & Hydraulic Dual Brakes] - The front suspension fork is strengthened by 100%, making it easier to navigate rough terrains. The rear hydraulic shock absorber offers superior performance compared to mechanical models. The mechanical dual brakes enhance safety by cutting braking distance by 50%, providing confidence even in wet conditions.
[Easy & Safe Riding] - The adult electric dirt bike features an advanced LCD that provides real-time metrics, adjustable parameters, and various trip-tracking options. With bright LED headlights and IP5 waterproof protection, you can enjoy safe riding in diverse road conditions. The bike has a maximum load capacity of 330 lbs.
[Features & Accessories] - The electric mountain bike includes a 7.2'' phone holder (18.5x8.5cm/7.3x3.4 inch) and a spacious storage box (22x14x11cm/8.6x5.5x4.3 inch). It also features a multi-function LCD, high brightness front light, and tail light for enhanced safety. With 90% pre-assembly, installation is a breeze.

[One-Year Warranty] - Established in New Jersey and proudly serving the US since 2008. Our products come 90% pre-assembled and include a 1-year warranty on the motor, battery, and charger. For any inquiries, feel free to reach out, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. //Please keep the original packaging for some time.

Introducing our versatile electric mountain bike, designed to excel in both your daily commute and conquering tough mountain trails.

With a powerful motor and durable fat tires, it handles any terrain with ease.
Experience the thrill of speed and adventure as you push its capabilities to the limit. Upgrade to our electric mountain bike and unleash your inner explorer.

Q16 Lite Fat Tire Electric Bike——Enhance Your Cycling Experience!

Powerful Motor
Equipped with a 1500W brushless motor , our e-bike conquers all terrains effortlessly. The robust controller ensures optimal motor performance and longevity.

Removable Battery
With a 48V 20Ah battery, our e-bike offers a range of 30 miles in pure electric mode and up to 50 miles in pedal-assist mode.
The removable design makes it convenient to take out and install the battery.

Super Bright Headlight and Brake Light
Our electric bike features waterproof headlights and brake lights, ensuring safe night riding. Ride with confidence and clarity, whether you're commuting after work or exploring new trails in the dark.

16"*4" Fat Tires
Conquer any surface with confidence using our electric mountain bike equipped with 16"*4.0" puncture-resistant fat tires, designed to handle grass, dirt, sand, snow, and gravel effortlessly

Double Shock Absorption
The front and rear suspension forks provide improved damping, ensuring a smooth and comfortable ride. Say goodbye to bumps on rough roads with our enhanced suspension system.

Dual Dual Brakes
Equipped with a dependable dual mechanical disc brake system, ensuring effective braking performance in a short amount of time. Enjoy the thrill of high-speed riding with enhanced safety.

LCD multi-function display
The LCD digital display provides clear visibility of speed, mileage, battery level, PAS, and other essential information.

Twist Grip Throttle & Shamano 7-Speed
Twisting the throttle releases your thumb for effortless speed control and enhanced safety. The Shimano 7-Speed system provides a wide shifting range, enabling smooth and precise gear changes on various surfaces.

1.Q: What are the benefits of fat tire e-bikes?
A: Fat tire e-bikes (with 16"*4" inches or wider tires) offer increased grip, traction, and stability, particularly at lower tire pressures. They excel in diverse terrains like snow and beaches, making them an ideal choice for exploration.
2.Q: How far can I ride on a full charge?
A: The range on a full charge is up to 30 miles in pure electric mode and up to 50 miles in pedal assist mode. The actual distance covered depends on factors like riding style, pedal assist/throttle usage, rider weight, terrain, and wind conditions.
3.Q: What is the e-bike's top speed?
A: The e-bike can reach a maximum speed of 28+++ mph in pure electric mode (ensure a full charge).
4.Q: What are the recommended height and weight limits for the Q16 Lite?
A: Recommended height range is 5.2 to 6.0 feet, with a maximum weight capacity of 330 lbs.
